clause: StudioRawDevelop non-destructive parametric graph + authority persistence [STU-RAW-001,STU-RAW-002]

scope.summary: Implement the canonical StudioRawDevelop primitive (schema id hsk.studio.raw_develop@1, field-owned by 14.23) as a non-destructive, re-editable, ordered parametric graph over an immutable decoded raw input: every Basic/Curve/Detail/Color/Optics/Geometry/Effects/Calibration adjustment, mask, and Enhance result stored as parameters+derived buffers, fully reversible to the as-decoded state, and bit-reproducible under a fixed process version. Develop authority persists as typed SCHEMAFULL studio_* SurrealDB records bound to EventLedger (studio.raw/studio.raster family) per [STU-ARC-003]/[STU-ARC-004], with no XMP sidecar, proprietary raw-settings database, PostgreSQL, or SQLite cache.
acceptance_criteria: StudioRawDevelop compiles + derives JsonSchema; non-destructive reversible graph; authority-row persistence; no sidecar/SQLite
proof_targets: bit-reproducible render + reversibility + authority-row persistence test
expected_tests: test: same raw+params+process-version renders bit-identical on same engine build
test: pipeline fully reversible to as-decoded state
test: develop state persists as authority rows (no XMP sidecar / no PostgreSQL/SQLite)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No re-editable develop core; raw edits fork types or leak to sidecar files (dedup + no-PostgreSQL/SQLite violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
